# The diagnostic code register — the "Codes" section of the
# error-handling specification. GENERATED by
# scripts/regen-diagnostic-codes.sh from the diagnostic_code! literals
# in the sources; do not hand-edit.
#
# Second column: whether any .whip file in this repository makes
# `whip check` or `whip lint` emit the code. The corpus is every
# .whip git tracks — examples/invalid/ and examples/diagnostics/ (the
# companion programs the docs' rendered samples come from) alike, plus
# the crate fixtures and the dogfood solutions. A code reached only by a
# companion program still counts: scripts/regen-docs-diagnostics.sh
# --check fails when one stops emitting the code its page documents,
# which is the guarantee the COVERED mark stands for. Quote a coverage
# figure with the corpus it was measured over; the count alone does not
# say.
#
# Both surfaces are the compiler emitting a registered code, and both are
# gated, so both count. `whip lint` joined when the lint codes
# joined the register: before that the linter minted them as bare
# strings, and no coverage question could be asked about them at all.
#
#   COVERED      the corpus reaches it. Append-only: it may not be renamed
#                or removed.
#   PROVISIONAL  nothing reaches it. Never observed coming out of the
#                compiler, so it is NOT yet under the append-only
#                guarantee and may still be corrected. It becomes stable
#                the moment a fixture reaches it.
